name: extension-paragraph-numbering-margin
description: The paragraph-numbering extension with `paragraph-numbering.placement: margin`, which draws the number beside the text instead of inside it. Three things need pinning and none are visible in the inline fixture. (1) Placement per column: the rightmost column's numbers go in the right-hand margin, every other column's on the left, so a two-column region reads outward with nothing in the gutter. (2) The fallback: a three-column region's INTERIOR column has only the 12pt gutter, which cannot hold a number, so those paragraphs number inline instead — a clipped number would be unreadable where an inline one is merely less pretty. (3) The page break: a number drawn before the converter decides where the text lands is stranded at the foot of the previous page. The upstream recipe this extension derives from fails exactly here, with `cannot fit formatted text on page` and a paragraph that renders with no number at all.
